name: Nikhil Bohra
desc_id: Pusat informasi untuk pembalap Indian-American di Formula Regional European Championship. Saya rangkai perjalanannya dari Italian F4 hingga podium FRECA — narasi karier yang menandakan kesiapan untuk investasi sponsor.
desc_en: An information hub for an Indian-American driver in the Formula Regional European Championship. I framed his journey from Italian F4 to the FRECA podium — a career narrative signalling readiness to sponsors.
